A '''[[Gender|male]]<ref name="Bounty" /> [[Nimbanel]]''' worked as a [[bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]], a [[spaceport]] located on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]] was hired to [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters|kidnap]] [[Che Amanwe Papanoida]] by the [[Trade Federation]] to pressure her [[Parent|father]], [[Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida]] of [[Pantora]], into aligning his world with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], hiding her in Chalmun's [[Cantina]]. However, Papanoida, along with his son [[Ion Papanoida|Ion]], captured Greedo and forced him to bring them to where he was holding Che Amanwe. As they entered the cantina, the Nimbanel anticipated a fight between the Papanoidas and Che Amanwe's kidnappers and sought cover behind the bar during the ensuing [[Rescue in Chalmun's Cantina|gunfight]].<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

Later in the war, the cantina was visited by former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]], who [[Death|killed]] the [[bounty hunter]] [[Oked]] when he tried flirting with her. He then gave Ventress a drink purchased for her by the bounty hunter Bossk, after which the Nimbanel removed Oked's corpse from the establishment.<ref name="Bounty" />

The bartender had [[Color|pink]] skin, black [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]] on his cheeks.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And also, we rationalize that the same owner probably didn't have it. So we created a bartender for our cantina. And I think that this guy was so traumatized by the shootout with Baron Papanoida that he put the cantina up for sale.|Dave Filoni|<ref name="Sphere of Influence Episode Featurette">{{SW|url=video/sphere-of-influence-episode-featurette|text="Sphere of Influence" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
This Nimbanel first appeared in "[[Sphere of Influence]]," the fourth episode of the [[canon]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]],<ref name="Sphere of Influence" /> which originally aired on [[October 1]], [[2010]].<ref name="Sphere of Influence air date">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sphere-of-influence-episode-guide|text="Sphere of Influence" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> He was created when it was rationalized that the cantina didn't have the same [[Wuher|owner]] during the Clone Wars, and Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] speculated that he was so traumatized by the episode's cantina shootout that he put it up for sale, allowing it to fall into the possession of its owner at the time of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Sphere of Influence Episode Featurette" /> Despite this, he later reappeared in "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]," the twentieth episode of ''The Clone Wars''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]],<ref name="Bounty" /> which originally aired on [[March 2]], [[2012]],<ref name="Bounty air date">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bounty-episode-guide|text="Bounty" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> where he was voiced by [[Matthew Senreich]] and credited simply as "Bartender."<ref name="Bounty" />
